Package com.pulumi.cloud.sdk

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    ApiClient
    HTTP engine for the generated Pulumi Cloud SDK, built on the JDK HttpClient.
    ApiClientConfiguration
    Connection settings shared by every generated *Api class.
    ApiRequest
    Mutable carrier populated by a generated *Api method before it hands the request to ApiClient.
    HeaderParsing
    Header-value parsing helpers for generated *Api methods whose response declares typed response headers.
    Json
    Shared, pre-configured Jackson ObjectMapper for the generated SDK.
    ResponseWithHeaders<R,​H>
    Pairs a deserialized response body with typed response headers, mirroring apitype.ResponseWithHeaders[R, H] (Go) / ResponseWithHeaders<R, H> (TypeScript / .NET) / ResponseWithHeaders[R, H] (Python).
  • Exception Summary 
    Exception Description
    ApiException
    Thrown for a non-2xx HTTP response, a transport failure, or a serialization/deserialization error.
